tender_title: EPC Contract for Kankrej Pipeline Project From Existing Changa Main Pumping Station Dist: Banaskantha
recommendation: Ensure compliance with AA Class registration with Gujarat State WRD / R&B, financial turnover of Rs. 69.78 Crores, single work experience of Rs. 27.91 Crores, and liquid assets of Rs. 17.45 Crores. If bidding as a JV, the lead partner must meet at least 51% share and 50% of financial criteria.
executive_summary: The tender requires bidders to have AA Class & Above registration with Gujarat State WRD / R&B, an average annual financial turnover of at least Rs. 69.78 Crores over the last 3 financial years, single work experience of at least Rs. 27.91 Crores for similar EPC pipeline / water supply works in the last 7 years, and liquid assets/credit facilities of at least Rs. 17.45 Crores. Joint Venture conditions specify a minimum 51% share for the lead partner and 50% fulfillment of financial criteria, with all partners combined meeting 100% of financial requirements.

clauses_breakdown.tender_requirement: Class of Registration: AA Class & Above with Gujarat State WRD / R&B
Average Annual Financial Turnover of the bidder during the last 3 financial years ending 31st March of previous financial year should be at least Rs. 69.78 Crores.
clauses_breakdown.required_doc: Audited Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Statements

clauses_breakdown.tender_requirement: The bidder must have successfully executed as prime contractor at least one similar EPC pipeline / water supply work of value not less than Rs. 27.91 Crores in the last 7 years.
Availability of liquid assets and/or credit facilities of not less than Rs. 17.45 Crores certified by a Chartered Accountant / Scheduled Bank.
clauses_breakdown.required_doc: Certificate from Chartered Accountant / Scheduled Bank

clauses_breakdown.clause_title: Joint Venture Share and Financial Criteria
clauses_breakdown.tender_requirement: Lead partner must hold at least 51% share and meet 50% of financial criteria. All partners combined must meet 100% of financial requirements.
